subject.title: Feature/Fix: Add conservative lineage safety and promotion controls

question: Should this stack remain shadow-only for now, or may this PR introduce a gated path that can make lineage accounting authoritative?
rationale: The gate mechanics are testable, but accepting a new authority for user-visible token and cost totals is a product and rollout policy choice that automation cannot make.

options.title: Keep shadow-only
options.body: Land non-authoritative comparison, containment, and diagnostics while deferring the lineage authority selector until broader validation exists.

options.title: Allow gated authority
options.body: Keep the selector after exact-head fresh-cache and retained-cache proof demonstrates safe authorization, cancellation, and legacy rollback.

recommendation.title: Keep shadow-only
recommendation.body: Land non-authoritative comparison, containment, and diagnostics while deferring the lineage authority selector until broader validation exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available owner for changing the authority and rollback contract of the cost scanner.
